US.regulation: Fair Credit Reporting Act, section 611 (15 U.S.C. 1681i)
US.text: Reinvestigate within 30 days of receipt (45 if the consumer sends more information). Notify the furnisher within 5 business days. If the information is inaccurate, incomplete or cannot be verified, delete or modify it. Send results to the consumer within 5 business days of completion. Identity theft: block reported information on receipt of an identity theft report (section 605B).

ZA.regulation: National Credit Act 34 of 2005, section 72 and Regulation 20
ZA.text: Resolve the dispute within 20 business days. If the bureau cannot find credible evidence supporting the information, remove it. Notify the consumer of the outcome.

IN.regulation: CICRA 2005 and RBI framework for credit information complaints (October 2023)
IN.text: Resolve within 30 calendar days: 21 days for the credit institution, 9 for the bureau. Compensation of INR 100 per day applies after that. Restructured or moratorium accounts must be reported as agreed with the lender.

UK.text: Respond within 28 days. Correct or remove the entry, or add the consumer's notice of correction, and tell the consumer what was done.
